title: Chation - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Chation in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Chation is a dark-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Luck (C), Vitality (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Chation
sections.content:
Location: Stone Wave Cliffs.

Obtained from Stone Wave Cliffs.

sections.title: Is the Chation Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Luck (C), Vitality (B). A dedicated dark pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
